name: Google Workspace Admin
hint: A web OAuth client in your Google Cloud project with the Admin SDK API enabled, and a Workspace admin’s refresh token for these scopes under https://www.googleapis.com/auth/: admin.directory.user.readonly, admin.directory.group.readonly, admin.directory.group.member, admin.directory.orgunit.readonly, admin.directory.device.chromeos.readonly, admin.directory.device.mobile.readonly, admin.directory.domain.readonly, admin.directory.rolemanagement.readonly, admin.reports.audit.readonly, admin.reports.usage.readonly, for example from the OAuth 2.0 Playground; an External app left in Testing gets tokens that end after 7 days.

endpoints.name: list_users
endpoints.description: Lists the users. Give customer my_customer for the account’s own organization, or domain for one domain; query searches, e.g. email:ada* or orgUnitPath=/Students. Without fields each user comes back whole: fields=users(primaryEmail,name/fullName,orgUnitPath,suspended),nextPageToken keeps the answer small.

notes.customer: The unique ID for the customer's Google Workspace account. In case of a multi-domain account, to fetch all users for a customer, use this field instead of `domain`. You can also use the `my_customer` alias to represent your account's `customerId`. The `customerId` is also returned as part of the [Us
notes.domain: The domain name. Use this field to get users from only one domain. To return all domains for a customer account, use the `customer` query parameter instead. Either the `customer` or the `domain` parameter must be provided.
notes.query: Query string for searching user fields. For more information on constructing user queries, see [Search for Users](https://developers.google.com/workspace/admin/directory/v1/guides/search-users).
notes.maxResults: Maximum number of results to return.
notes.orderBy: Property to use for sorting results.
notes.pageToken: Token to specify next page in the list. The page token is only valid for three days.
notes.projection: What subset of fields to fetch for this user.
notes.viewType: Whether to fetch the administrator-only or domain-wide public view of the user. For more information, see [Retrieve a user as a non-administrator](https://developers.google.com/workspace/admin/directory/v1/guides/manage-users#retrieve_users_non_admin).
notes.fields: Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.

endpoints.name: get_user
endpoints.description: Returns one user, by primary email, alias or ID; projection full adds the custom schema fields.

notes.userKey: Identifies the user in the API request. The value can be the user's primary email address, alias email address, or unique user ID.
notes.projection: What subset of fields to fetch for this user.

endpoints.name: list_groups
endpoints.description: Lists groups. Give customer my_customer for the account’s own organization, or domain; for the groups one user is in, give userKey and no customer. query searches, e.g. email:support* or name:contact*.

notes.customer: The unique ID for the customer's Google Workspace account. In case of a multi-domain account, to fetch all groups for a customer, use this field instead of `domain`. You can also use the `my_customer` alias to represent your account's `customerId`. The `customerId` is also returned as part of the [U
notes.domain: The domain name. Use this field to get groups from only one domain. To return all domains for a customer account, use the `customer` query parameter instead.
notes.userKey: Email or immutable ID of the user if only those groups are to be listed, the given user is a member of. If it's an ID, it should match with the ID of the user object. Cannot be used with the `customer` parameter.
notes.query: Query string search. Contains one or more search clauses, each with a field, operator, and value. For complete documentation, go to [Search for groups](https://developers.google.com/workspace/admin/directory/v1/guides/search-groups).
notes.maxResults: Maximum number of results to return. Max allowed value is 200.
notes.pageToken: Token to specify next page in the list

endpoints.name: get_group
endpoints.description: Returns one group, by email address, alias or ID.

notes.groupKey: Identifies the group in the API request. The value can be the group's email address, group alias, or the unique group ID.

endpoints.name: list_group_members
endpoints.description: Lists a group’s members, users and groups, each with its role: OWNER, MANAGER or MEMBER. includeDerivedMembership true also lists indirect members.

notes.groupKey: Identifies the group in the API request. The value can be the group's email address, group alias, or the unique group ID.
notes.roles: The `roles` query parameter allows you to retrieve group members by role. Allowed values are `OWNER`, `MANAGER`, and `MEMBER`.
notes.includeDerivedMembership: Whether to list indirect memberships. Default: false.
notes.maxResults: Maximum number of results to return. Max allowed value is 200.
notes.pageToken: Token to specify next page in the list.

endpoints.name: list_org_units
endpoints.description: Lists organizational units. customerId my_customer is the account’s own organization; type all lists every level under orgUnitPath, the default only the immediate children.

notes.customerId: The unique ID for the customer's Google Workspace account. As an account administrator, you can also use the `my_customer` alias to represent your account's `customerId`. The `customerId` is also returned as part of the [Users resource](https://developers.google.com/workspace/admin/directory/v1/refe
notes.orgUnitPath: The full path to the organizational unit or its unique ID. Returns the children of the specified organizational unit.
notes.type: Whether to return all sub-organizations or just immediate children.

endpoints.name: get_user_usage
endpoints.description: Returns usage statistics per user for one day: userKey all or one user’s email, date yyyy-mm-dd in Pacific Standard Time; parameters picks them, e.g. accounts:timestamp_last_login. A day whose data is not ready comes back with a warning.

notes.userKey: Represents the profile ID or the user email for which the data should be filtered. Can be `all` for all information, or `userKey` for a user's unique Google Workspace profile ID or their primary email address. Must not be a deleted user. For a deleted user, call `users.list` in Directory API with `s
notes.date: Represents the date the usage occurred, based on UTC-8:00 (Pacific Standard Time). The timestamp is in the [ISO 8601 format](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601), `yyyy-mm-dd`.
notes.parameters: The `parameters` query string is a comma-separated list of event parameters that refine a report's results. The parameter is associated with a specific application. The application values for the Customers Usage report include `accounts`, `app_maker`, `apps_scripts`, `calendar`, `chat`, `classroom`,
notes.filters: The `filters` query string is a comma-separated list of an application's event parameters where the parameter's value is manipulated by a relational operator. The `filters` query string includes the name of the application whose usage is returned in the report. The application values for the Users U
notes.maxResults: Determines how many activity records are shown on each response page. For example, if the request sets `maxResults=1` and the report has two activities, the report has two pages. The response's `nextPageToken` property has the token to the second page. The `maxResults` query string is optional.
notes.pageToken: Token to specify next page. A report with multiple pages has a `nextPageToken` property in the response. In your follow-on request getting the next page of the report, enter the `nextPageToken` value in the `pageToken` query string.

endpoints.name: get_customer_usage
endpoints.description: Returns the organization’s usage statistics for one day: date yyyy-mm-dd in Pacific Standard Time; parameters picks them, e.g. accounts:num_30day_logins. A day whose data is not ready comes back with a warning.

notes.parameters: The `parameters` query string is a comma-separated list of event parameters that refine a report's results. The parameter is associated with a specific application. The application values for the Customers usage report include `accounts`, `app_maker`, `apps_scripts`, `calendar`, `chat`, `classroom`,
notes.pageToken: Token to specify next page. A report with multiple pages has a `nextPageToken` property in the response. For your follow-on requests getting all of the report's pages, enter the `nextPageToken` value in the `pageToken` query string.

endpoints.name: list_chromeos_devices
endpoints.description: Lists ChromeOS devices. customerId my_customer is the account’s own organization; query filters, e.g. status:provisioned or recent_user:ada@school.edu, and projection FULL returns every field.

notes.customerId: The unique ID for the customer's Google Workspace account. As an account administrator, you can also use the `my_customer` alias to represent your account's `customerId`. The `customerId` is also returned as part of the [Users resource](https://developers.google.com/workspace/admin/directory/v1/refe
notes.query: Search string in the format given at [List query operators](https://developers.google.com/workspace/admin/directory/v1/list-query-operators).
notes.orgUnitPath: The full path of the organizational unit (minus the leading `/`) or its unique ID.
notes.includeChildOrgunits: Return devices from all child orgunits, as well as the specified org unit. If this is set to true, 'orgUnitPath' must be provided.
notes.projection: Determines whether the response contains the full list of properties or only a subset.
notes.maxResults: Maximum number of results to return. Value should not exceed 300.
notes.pageToken: The `pageToken` query parameter is used to request the next page of query results. The follow-on request's `pageToken` query parameter is the `nextPageToken` from your previous response.
